description: User says 'actually I don't work there anymore'. Expected: old fact has valid_to set to the correction timestamp; new fact is written as active; retrieval excludes the old fact unless history is explicitly requested; superseded_by on the old item points to the new item's ID. Signal and memory-op traces are skeleton placeholders pending Stage 4 activation.

fixture_conventions.correction_trigger: The correction is implicit: user asserts a new value for a previously stored fact without an explicit 'forget' or 'delete' command. The system must detect the conflict and apply bi-temporal supersession.
fixture_conventions.bi_temporal_supersession: Old MemoryItem: valid_to set to correction timestamp; superseded_by set to new item's ID. New MemoryItem: valid_from set to correction timestamp; superseded_by unset. Both items are retained in history; normal retrieval returns only the new item.
fixture_conventions.retrieval_exclusion: Retrieval queries without an explicit history flag must return only the new (active) fact. The old fact is accessible only when the caller explicitly requests historical items.
fixture_conventions.superseded_by_linkage: The superseded_by field on the old item must point to the new item's ID. This closes the provenance DAG per invariant #3.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels. Filled in at Stage 4 activation.

signal_trace.note: Per-frame scripted values are placeholders. To be finalized when Stage 4 is activated.

memory_op_trace.note: Memory operation sequence (pre-existing fact, correction utterance, supersession write, old item invalidation) to be scripted at Stage 4 activation.
